title: fix(skills): rank hub search results by trust before the limit cut
claim: GET /api/skills/hub/search must trust-sort merged results before the [:limit] cut (like unified_search), so builtin/trusted hits are not truncated behind a faster community source; on main it cuts in as_completed order.

evidence.red: tests only on main: tests/hermes_cli/test_dashboard_admin_endpoints.py -> 42 passed, 1 failed; TestSkillsHubSearchEndpoint::test_trust_rank_survives_limit_cut: AssertionError 'At index 0 diff: 'skills-sh/x/s0' != 'official/cat/s-official''
evidence.negative_control: inverted sort key (ascending trust) -> TestSkillsHubSearchEndpoint 0 passed, 1 failed with the same index-0 diff; restored
evidence.adjacent: tests/hermes_cli/test_web_server_skills_profiles.py tests/hermes_cli/test_web_server_skill_editor.py tests/tools/test_skill_bundle_provenance.py tests/tools/test_skills_hub_browse_sh.py -> 4 files, 38 passed, 0 failed; ruff clean
evidence.source: main hermes_cli/web_routers/skills.py:201-208 dedupes then `list(seen.values())[:capped]` with no sort; tools/skills_hub_search.py:261-270 unified_search sorts by -TRUST_RANK before [:limit]; hermes_cli/skills_hub.py _rank_and_page also sorts. Dashboard endpoint is the lone outlier.

upstream_overlap: None owning this defect. #116108 OPEN (nikkoxgonzales) adds opt-in relevance rerank to unified_search only (files: tools/skills_hub_search.py, tools/skills_hub_rerank.py, config) — does not touch web_routers/skills.py.
#113118 MERGED (index-miss fallback) touched hub search but not ordering.
notes: Rebuilt on current main (router now imports parallel_search_sources from tools.skills_hub_search and uses _hub_sources(profile); fork's patch targeted the old tools.skills_hub seam and its test patched hermes_cli.web_server._installed_hub_identifiers, which is no longer the lookup site). Test trimmed to one contract test reusing the module's _FakeMeta. Kanban baggage dropped. NOT_TESTED: live dashboard against real hub sources.
lead_review: Lead spot-check: RED reproduced (builtin entry cut by completion-order slice), GREEN 43/43 in test_dashboard_admin_endpoints.py. Stable sort by existing _rank before [:capped].
